title: Was this a lighting upgrade, downgrade, or neutral?
author: Sea-Sandwich-8348
selftext:
I think it looks quite a bit better, and less washed out. Second opinions welcome!

This is an incremental game mobile game where you drive around and collect golf balls to earn money to upgrade your range. Currently only released on the web, but mobile release coming soon.
